notes.title: TECH DEMO RELEASE-!
notes.notes:
Good morning, afternoon, and evening—!

We’ve just released the Tech Demo build for everyone to try out! Please keep in mind, this is a tech demo or vertical slice—it is not a full game, and not even a true demo. You can play as one of three dragons or as a human. Humans will be able to equip armour and weapons for combat. This release is intended to showcase what we can achieve with minimal funding, and will run alongside our current [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/the-wings-of-dawn/x/30107787#/]Indiegogo[/url] campaign.

At present, we are aware of several game-breaking bugs, primarily affecting human characters. For example, being struck may cause your character to fall through the world—this will be fixed as soon as possible. Human hands are currently not appearing on weapons, and some animations appear to be bugged. We're not sure why this has happened, as the previous build was functioning correctly—but such is the life of a game developer!

Servers have been reduced from 100 down to 40 as we found that our networking currently won't support large numbers of players, this is currently being worked on but won't be ready before the end of the tech demo. If 40 is too much we will reduce it again but double the server count where needed.

Below are the current commands and controls available in the tech demo:

/growth 1 (makes you an adult)
/growth 0 (makes you a hatchling)

notes.title: First update of the Year
notes.notes:
Good morning, afternoon and evening everyone!

This week's development update features our backend development on the test build, including some other human-related stuff. Featuring this week's progress with Team Humans!

[b]Human Combat on Its Way~[/b]

@𝕱𝖊𝖓𝖗𝖎𝖗 the Pigeon has kept the human melee combat as the current focus, as it needs to be as polished as possible before its release. It is tough to make it feel and work well considering the current limitations in this early prototype build, but progress is currently being made slowly but surely. Now that the holidays are finished Fenrir can resume working as much as possible and progress should hopefully go as smoothly as possible.

[b]Hatchet's Developer Notes~[/b]

- Redone the dragon lock-on system to relieve its load on network and server performance!
In our testing, we found that one of our major network bottlenecks has been replicated variables on tick-events, which simply just means that some variable values are being synced between servers and clients every frame for everyone. While some of that is unavoidable, it's most definitely not needed in the projectile lock-on system, so with the overhaul, we should see at least some improved network performance.

- Began work on redoing some dragon movement code to be server-authoritative!
The dragons' movement is currently client-authoritative for movement smoothness, but it also means that server-side accuracy is sacrificed in the process. In order to facilitate the re-enabling of player-player collision, our goal is to have the movement be server-authoritative in the end while still retaining the current level of client-side smoothness.

- Assorted bug fixes and improvements!
What it says on the tin.  Decided to type out these things as well so you don't need to.

notes.title: Weekly update
notes.notes:
Good morning, afternoon and evening everyone!

This Monday's weekly development update is with Team Human's turn. First of all: welcome to all newcomers who have joined our small community lately! We do weekly development updates on our game: we rotate between three (3) fields: creatures, humans and world. This helps our team produce efficient and regular updates to you all. Now for the update~

Hatchet's Programming Recipe~

One of our two programmers @Hatchet has been fixing bugs, editing and perfecting existing mechanics within our test build. Some of these include:

[list]
[*]
[/list]Weather now resets back to the default 10 minutes after the /weather command. This should prevent the randomized weather system getting 'stuck' in set weather when the command has been run. Hatchet calls this 執手尾 (translation: tidying up)
[list]
[*]
[/list]Various balancing updates to all dragon stats. This means that the dragons behave more like their intended species within the game. Further testing for this is required and this will be up for our Patreon testers shortly.

[list]
[*]
[/list]Implemented a new "over-the-shoulder aiming" mechanic for grounded dragons: this will help you aim those fire balls, ice spheres and lightning bolts better. This can be toggled on and off.


DISCLAIMER: below video is a work-in-progress (WIP) toggle-aiming mechanic for all of our currently test version dragons: Vulgan, Icy Crown and Kirin in order. This is a rough first version of the mechanic and will be adjusted and edited later down the line. We are going to zoom it in more so that the creatures that have wings will not have wings clipping over the camera.

[b]Fenrir's Human Combat Overhaul~[/b]

Our second programmer @Fenrir is overhauling the code for human combat. The previous one that was setup, a placeholder that came with some of our placeholder marketplace assets did not feel good and was rather messy. So instead of going through every single step in a command thread, it felt way more easier to make a new system with more flexibility and that is far better optimised. Currently a work in progress~


NEW! Medium Iron Armour 3D Model Sheet!

Our @pebb has been working hard with creating the next 3D model sheet for our 3D artist responsible with human armour. With the heavy iron armour soon to be finished, the next one is already being added into the queue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191194/da155d8d36e193ad1c27d82d8b17c90708ad6b60.jpg[/img]

Here is a material breakdown through using different colours. This is especially handy for 3D artists when they create the 3D model and require better visual on when creating the textures and materials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191194/b738261d81f8a5091b8f14bf6372bd846b802f2b.jpg[/img]

[b]PROGRESS! On the Heavy Iron Armour 3D Model![/b]

Speaking of the heavy iron armour for the humans, sculpting the trousers was finished recently: the next step retopoly and UV cutting. The set is slowly but surely coming very nicely together don't you all agree? Its looking real fancy~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191194/70538c626062d193c982759fd236e91deb335d74.jpg[/img]


[list]

[/list]Here we have a visual of the trousers with the leg guards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191194/f173d814995f6780dd290e86ca8b775c89383c74.jpg[/img]

Here is what the lower torso looks like with the trousers, leg guards and the waist armour pieces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191194/56ecaae880c399b66b4d47aa4cb331808258709a.jpg[/img]

And here is the entire torso with the armour. This is the front view with the included chest and shoulder crystal decorations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191194/8ef1eea5c7b9cab60c9e7747749649f91a242236.jpg[/img]


And here is the entire torso with the armour. This is the back view with the included chest and shoulder crystal decorations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191194/4a54f051e149e56c9f703cbdf716dbaffbc2e4c5.jpg[/img]


Of course you cannot show off the package without the helmet. Removed the waist armour bits so that the trousers are properly visible. You have to respect the incredible detail this fantastic artist is putting into their work. His behind looks a little 'empty' without that chain protection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191194/7fdaa93144ce4caf8cbe1219e625f9478f914f37.jpg[/img]


[b]NEW! Custom Human Animations on the Way![/b]

Let's take a look at some of our custom human animations! Since humans are first-person: we need to make some adjustments, more specifically we need to make slightly different animations for the first-person view (what the player sees) and the third-person view (what other players see). This is because you cannot use third-person animations with a first-person camera: it would not fit and oftentimes make the body clip straight through the camera and obstruct the player's view completely. For example: you would end up seeing the inside or even the back of the character's head during the clipping. Additionally the first-person view needs a more stable view for the movement so it doesn't cause nausea or motion sickness.

Here SadEch has animated a simple punch. It will need some tweaks that's mostly just wrist and twist bones and other blending for smooth effect. Using the third person/ full body punch as a reference to get the timing correctly so when a punch is registered, it visually matches up with the two different perspectives. Very cursed first person animation-- but don't worry the only thing you ever see from this animation is on the upper left side of the screen. The little light grey square is the only visible bit. In short: Whatever happens outside the camera's view in the first-person view is nothing of concern at all. You'd never see it anyway and that's how games trick you in every FPS haha!

First up is the first-person view~ The top left right corner is what the human player will see from their perspective. Pair of handsss.


For the videos please head over to the discord-!

notes.title: Weekly update
notes.notes:
Good morning, afternoon and evening everyone!

This week's development update is a day behind the usual Monday Schedule, but we wanted to let people cook some extra content. Today is Team World turn to share their work from the previous three weeks. Let's get started!

[b]Optimisation and Asset Update~[/b]

This week we spend most time looking at performance and further tweaking. We will spare you the details but to make it short: Nanite hates masked materials and loves full geometry. This has lead into us having to look at our assets at closer detail and scrap some of them that dependent a lot on masked materials.

So we looked at assets for that and long story short... the pines are gone. The pine forest that we had proved to be incompatible with Nanite, meaning that we unfortunately had come to a dead end. We would have to make our own pine forest assets in order to make things work, assets which we at this time and moment do not have.

The "now former pine forest" map does not go to waste however! Noa has gone and removed the pines and replaced them with far more performance friendly assets that are compatible with Nanite (better optimised). We are going to re-use the map essentially. That way nothing is completely scrapped. The map now looks vastly differenet (except the landscape of course). This is purely to offer the best performance and for that Noa would sacrifice pines all day.


[b]So what DOES the test map look like now?[/b]

So here is the current state: the map at the moment only has a wetlands biome available. The assets that we had used for wetlands previously proved to be one of the handful of assets that were still capable of fitting into the performance requirements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191194/764e33dd66116a109c345338c9108b772fe40993.jpg[/img]

Do not worry, we do not plan on making the entire map into wetlands. For reference the lowest point(s) of the map are going to be wetlands. Nothing above the ground level (or lines featured in below image) will receive that biome either. Which makes it look very empty at the moment BUT we have witnessed better performance already!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191194/7323b5ed97360497bd8500a444eb78c186ad9226.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191194/8b032b2795f3631ea151c07c00a86cf778c88267.jpg[/img]

There are still some issues popping up so we are working on it.

TL;DR: we have learned lots of things through experimenting and testing what works. That is all part of game development progress, sometimes you simply run into dead ends and have to learn alternatives and adapt into situations. Lots of tweaking and replacing and we are slowly getting there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191194/04ce9115d565d36c815bdd6277bfd052237896d3.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Noa's shoutout to SadEch for being a part of Team World for a huge while. 🤝
[/list]

SadEch is joining the world creation team for a moment to help optimise some of the human structure assets that we will be using in the monuments and placeholders for player buildings in the future.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191194/f3e563dd3b4e057f428ffb48ff04136d518b7376.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191194/33ad28a3e3ea15ba82555e9db109e6430007fdb8.jpg[/img]


[b]NEW! Human Structure Assets + Enter SadEch![/b]

To add on to Noa's bit: our SadEch is joining Team World for a little while, working on optimisation of all our assets. Which means, to take the current assets of building parts (walls, floors, roofs, pillars, and everything else) and manually making them into a high fidelity nanite-friendly asset.

Here's just some of the assets SadEch has to convert manually, to a much higher triangle count than they are currently. It will take time, but the results will be a lot better than they are currently. In the long run, it will be performance enhancing and thus it's worth the time to convert existing bought assets, into more customised, nanite-ready objects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191194/f9252cad9f3acc90c836785f41c83c444ecf088a.png[/img]


But that's everything this week , not as large as normal however it is very important to do -!

[b]NEW! Creature Concept Art~[/b]

Nika has completed yet another stunning looking critter. Another cave AI creature that will be crawling around with six limbs. Ceiling Ambusher. This large spider lives in the darkness of Aleria's caves, patiently waiting for its prey to come close to its nest. If you discover parts of caves covered in thick spider webs, it may be a good idea to run away as fast as you can.
 
Ceiling ambusher - as its name suggests - sits on the cave ceiling, hanging upside down, and when creature or a human comes anywhere near its hiding place, it will quickly jump on them, trying to inject them with its paralyzing venom, as quickly as possible. It can also grab smaller creatures and even humans with its arms, and try to eat it alive, while still hanging from the ceiling. Truly horrifying creature, that makes many people and dragons stay away from the cave areas.

notes.title: Experimental performance update!
notes.notes:
The game server was down earlier today due to developers testing out a new update on the dev-branch. The update went smooth and we are now releasing to everyone else!

It's a performance enhancing update that should make everything a bit more smooth!

[list]
[*] We are aware that people may spawn under the map, if you don't let it load before spawning in, so give it a moment!
[*] Texture Scalability is at default at zero(0) and makes everything blurry, set it to minimum 50%!
[*] Humans are still in heavy WIP, Don't mind their bugs and problems : )
[*] When changing a lot of settings please restart your game to fix all visual glitches!
[*] "Video memory has been exhausted" pop-up. We are aware of it, and working on it actively, don't mind it.
[/list]

[u]If you are still having performance issues do this![/u]
Press F1 when in-game, then write the following command:
r.Nanite.MaxPixelsPerEdge 4
or
r.Nanite.MaxPixelsPerEdge 8

Use 4 for normal use, and 8 if it's really bad.

Changes:
[list]
[*] World Partitioned the Map.
[*] Enabled Nanite for missing meshes like the ruins.
[*] Put RVT on the landscape.
[*] Nanite for the Char select island.
[*] Moved Camera actor to that too.
[*] RVT Tweaks to have the ground less blurry.
[*] Changed Food Cube to Nanite Cubes.
[*] Tweaks to Materials.
[*] Tweaks to Pine Cliff Collision.
[*] Added Green Berries.
[*] Added a .ini type
[*] Edited some .inis
[/list]

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update
notes.notes:
Good morning, afternoon and evening everyone!

Greetings to all and especially to all newcomers! Welcome to our weekly development update where we share and show what our team has working with. Those who are new to our server: we have split our team into three (3) teams; creatures, world and programming with other backend progress. To keep up the efficient weekly schedule we cycle through these three teams and give all three weeks time to show something off in their team's turn. This way nobody gets burnt out!


[b]NEW Cactus Cruncher - Creature Concept![/b]

This is the smallest subspecies of Woodcracker, and it lives in a hot and dry desert areas. They are very smart and curious, so if not spooked or provoked, they may be relatively easy to tame and teach. They can survive in very high temperatures, but if it is too hot, they are known to dig a holes in the sand and spend the hottest part of the day inside, and while they are spending those days underground, you can still notice their eyes and noses above the ground, so it is advised to watch out for their spiky eyebrows.

[b]Cactus Cruncher[/b] diet is composed of just cacti, they are not eating anything else. Those animals are opening a cactus with their large beaks and claws, and once the top is gone, they will eat insides of a cactus, leaving prickly shells behind. They can also survive for weeks without drinking water, as long as they have plenty of cacti to eat and hydrate. But  they still have to drink water from time to time. They are very fast for a medium sized herbivore. They may be great companions for desert areas. Smart, agile and helpful to their masters. They are very effective against scorpions. 

Disadvantages: They can't stand temperatures below 0 degrees Celsius, that's why they won't be useful companions for humans who prefer colder climates.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/964564580242194452/1267587212694917240/Cactus_Muncher_kopia_2.png?ex=66a9fcd6&is=66a8ab56&hm=f42ffbaa9b7bff81ae0c3915a4745907b38df52f4a6aed863a8384680a9c8daa&[/img]

[b]NEW Arctic Woodcracker- Creature Concept![/b]

Arctic Woodcracker subspecies, second biggest subspecies. They feeds on moss, lichen plants, needles from small conifers and roots, which they dig from under the snow and ground with its strong hooves and claws. It is possibly the strongest of all subspecies, and able to withstand very low temperatures. Additionally it can go for days without eating much, on the other hand, they can't survive long without water. 

Disadvantages: They can't survive in temperatures above +10 degrees Celsius, meaning that they will not be efficient companions to players who prefer hotter climates.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/964564580242194452/1267587268600664156/Arctic_Cracker.png?ex=66a9fce3&is=66a8ab63&hm=14c3e6036f2563316352b90f9018c2ca0eb8d76b09a4452ec0faddaa70a3a037&[/img]


[b]WORK IN PROGRESS Dustrius 3D Model Sculpting![/b]

One of our 3D artists, Flow has been continuing sculpting progress with our 6th playable dragon Dustrius! This rocket punching medium herbivore dragon is going to be backing up a lot of fire power. Pun intended.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/964564580242194452/1267587367603146833/image.png?ex=66a9fcfb&is=66a8ab7b&hm=2a010bb1eb9d274b9542628bde8c8a5bfe30cd8540bf6ca0f9fcb7e1c4dc5885&[/img]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/964564580242194452/1267587388574797884/image.png?ex=66a9fd00&is=66a8ab80&hm=a72b9531b330abf2bad47986b9a82612540d6afaed571da28192777ac958b0d7&[/img]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/964564580242194452/1267587410305351741/image-1.png?ex=66a9fd05&is=66a8ab85&hm=3254fc944a7d7a9d273238e7ef624a03e21a930522ebb49c2fcf91d1e159be17&[/img]


[b]UPDATED Icy Crown Animations~[/b]

SadEch [Mother of Williams] has been working on updating and giving a quality of life update to Icy Crown. There has been a massive animation overhaul with updating all of the past and older animations. Please not that the animations showcased may appear faster in the video provided as in the game animation speed is dependant on the character's velocity and speed. Though we will polish animations further in the later development, this is how we are choosing to leave Icy Crown for now for the tech demo and move onto updating other aspects of the creatures, such as animating our AI.

[previewyoutube=-PZdV4B78Rc;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]NEW Wraith AI Creature Animations![/b]

Speaking of AI, @SadEch [Mother of Williams] is also working on animating the Wraith. This massive predator is an AI creature that humans can encounter in the world and tame. We gave our community a task to vote in ⁠dev-polls on which people wanted to see being animated in our development update livestreams on Sundays: and Wraith doubled down and took the cake and probably ate it too!

So far simple animations are being created to provide some first sprinkles of personality and characteristics for the creature. An idle animation is a great way to start.

(YOU WILL HAVE TO JOIN DISCORD TO SEE AS I CANNOT POST GIFS :c )

[b]Updates from our lead skin artist~[/b]

Our lead skin artists, SinfulVox has been busy with the skin system, here is some progression update message from him in his words!

Due to limited amounts of time, I have not been able to finish a new skin. However, I have been working in Unreal with the colour customisation. Here is a list of what I have been able to make:

- Implemented all previously shown Static Kirin skins to the build
- Paradise Kirin is now a customizable in terms of its coloration's

Colour Swatches: When starting out, players will have a mostly limited colour palette they can work with when creating their dragon's skin. These swatches will either be themed around the skin or will be based around the original colour palette of the static skin. As players advanced through the game, the ability to have all colours available to them will be unlocked.

- Created an RGB themed Colour Swatch for Grimm Aurora Icy. This still needs minor tweaks
- Created a Limited Colour Swatch for Paradise Kirin, however this swatch needs to be heavily adjusted still

The videos below show a brief demonstration of Grim Aurora Icy and Paradise Kirin's customisation. Again understand that there are still adjustments to be made to both colour palettes.

(YOU WILL HAVE TO JOIN DISCORD TO SEE AS I CANNOT POST GIFS :c )

[b]What's our sound designers doing?[/b]

OmniSound’s focus has been on moving from FMOD to Meta Sound and setting up infrastructure within the session to allow for a seamless move on the audio front. For the Icy Crown we made sure the that the flying sounds are synced correctly. We also tweaked a lot of individual assets, because of the switch to MetaSound a lot of sounds need some finetuning that was previously done in FMOD.

[b]Something from the Patreon Test Patch![/b]

Last but not least we have been hosting stress testing meetings with our Patreon supporters! What is a "stress test"? Stress testing is summoning as many testers into a server as possible to test out game features and seeking feedback on current version of the build. Since our latest patch has improved game performance immensely, it has been one of our primary concerns during the recent stress tests. So far we have been receiving great performance feedback and especially the low end computers are feeling the improvement!

[previewyoutube=dxDvwDYeEi8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Weekly steam update
notes.notes:
Good morning, afternoon and evening everyone!

Hello! Hello! This week's development update is baked and ready to be shared! Today it is our programmers time to share some of their development and what has been done. We also would like to introduce a new talented member into the team!

Shall we begin?


[b]Polishing Dragon Customisation System~[/b]

Hatchet has been working on further work with the skin customisation system for the dragons. It now includes support for multiple swatches, hues and value sliders: this means that you can pick and colour different areas and patterns of the body and change the saturation and brightness of the said colours. We are also currently adding and testing the limitations set to prevent albinism and melanism from being produced on skins that are not pigment mutations.

The dragon skin customisation now works with all dragons: Vulgan, Icy Crown and Kirin! All have one (1) fully functional customisation skin and we will be working on to adding more in the near future.


[b]Implemented the Overhaul Ability System![/b]

Some more polishing has been done for the modular combat system set for dragons. The new melee attacks have been implemented with the new ability system, though beware that we have not yet enabled elemental attacks as they are still a work in progress. We are also balancing and adjusting combat related damage input.

We are also going to be introducing new forms of receiving damage outside of combat. Beware the next time you jump off cliffs will you?


[b]UPDATED Animations and More![/b]

SadEch has finished updating some of Icy Crown's animations and given them some much needed upgrades. We have heard our community feedback and given a little bit more weight and respectable "cleaning". Plus a few small updates to our animation system to make the animations blend way better. No more of those pesky dislocating frames and body parts!



[b]HUMAN Gameplay Overhaul~[/b]

Fenrir on the other than has been starting to work overhauling the human game play for the tech demo. There has been made changes to the first-person camera to make it look and feel better, as in the past the camera sensitivity did cause discomfort for some of our testers. The old code has begun to be replaced with new, more modular and hopefully more performant code. Started integrating new assets into existing blueprints and replacing old human animations with new improved animation packs.



[b]What has our senior programmer been up to?[/b]

Over the past few weeks, I've made good progress in several areas. Our infrastructure improvements are now complete, with Horde, P4, and UGS fully set up and integrated on our new server. This new system has streamlined our build and distribution processes considerably, and ill be migrating core members of the team over the next few days and monitoring server stability. Currently, I'm focusing on finalizing the Epic Online Services integration, which includes implementing Easy Anti-Cheat. As part of this, I've been refactoring our Steamworks implementation to ensure smooth compatibility with EOS, and dropping some older dependencies like SteamCore and FMODStudio. As part of the new EOS integration, I've been working on session hosting and developing an in-game session browser similar to other games, so we can support multiple servers and community hosting. I've also been focusing on performance improvements, conducting rendering optimizations for the client and network performance enhancements for the server, based on profiling of both and by adjusting a lot of our default settings for different actors and blueprints we commonly use.


[b]In the other notes:[/b]

.    Whole host of bug fixes has been performed both old and new bugs have been squashed.
.    We have also added a new (though temporary) app icon!


[b]WORK IN PROGRESS Iron Armour Model Sheets![/b]

Last but not least we would like for you all to welcome our newest member to our development team pebb! This friendly fellow will be creating 3D model sheets to our armour and we must say they are in a gorgeous detail just like our 3D artists want them. These model sheets are created to assist our 3D artists in the final 3D model creation and which speeds up the development pipeline very well.

Here we have a work in progress heavy iron armour 3D model sheets! Chest plate and Leggings (with and without knee covers) are both finished, I want to add a separate sketch for the knuckles on the gloves, otherwise those are finished as well 
the helmet still needs a little attention and the boots only need a clean up for the top and below view.

Good morning, afternoon and evening everyone!

Another Tuesday and another weekly developer update! Today we have Noa showcasing level design work on the map(s). This week less topics, but bigger impacts and what's this? A new map? Oho! Let's take a look! 

Reminder to our Patrons that the Patreon test build is still down for maintenance. We are currently setting up server options and making sure that currently being rebuild and new features work as intended. Once we are happy with our private testing, we will be releasing it to our Patreon supporters to further testing.



[b]NEW DEATH MATCH TOURNAMENT ARENA![/b]

A very popular suggestion to us has been a human deathmatch battle arena. This has been very much requested by future server owners and some of our content creators as well. So to add something interesting specifically for our human players and PvP enjoyers, we have given our level designer @Noa a task to create a simple round tournament arena map with some variety.

The theme for this arena was [b]Ice and Fire[/b]. Not something that our level designer is used to, but Noa stepped up for the challenge! On either sides of the map there will be two fortresses where the humans begin their conquest. The human players will be split into two teams and the goal is to defeat and take over the enemy team's fortress. This is how far we have gotten so far, estimated around 80% completed. Noa has done his best and has been really fast at work! More detail will be added overtime.

notes.title: Weekly update
notes.notes:
Good morning, afternoon and evening everyone-!

So here is our second weekly update of July and it was a creature update so here are a few things that we have got up to-!

Today is another creature -themed developer update. This week's update is a little shorter all things considered that our sound team is assisting our programmers to implement new sounds into the test build, and SadEch is on her long waited vacation to release some steam.

To share some of our progress: we are currently due to releasing one of our largest updates to our test build yet, so the the test build server is going to be offline for a few days until we have perfected and given it more polish. We are going to be squishing some bugs and troubleshooting on our own end before we release our hungry Patreons to do a bigger wave of bug hunting.


[b]NEW CREATURE CONCEPT: The Forest Grazer![/b]

The Forest Grazer a temperate forest subspecies of Woodcracker,  it is a large-medium herbivore and second smallest of the Woodcracker -subspecies. It lives only in temperate forests, feeding on ferns, moss, mushrooms and smaller bushes, such as blueberry bushes, which have softer branches. They are not able to chew on wood in a way that their Redwood cousins can. It's beak and teeth are unable to crack hard wood, that's why Forest Grazers are chewing in a way that is similar to the moose. 

Forest Gazer are a relatively intelligent animal. They thrive in moderate temperatures, but won't die in cooler or warmer areas. It can be a good mount for human players, able to carry heavy load for a long distances. This subspecies is the most moderate of all Woodcracker -subspecies, it is neither the strongest, nor the weakest. It is way faster than bigger members of Woodcracker family, but much slower than desert variant. 

They are one of the loudest subspecies, with their skin above beak (bright red/pink part) being able to inflate and deflate a little bit, adding interesting tunes to their calls. It can be compared to humpback whale songs.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/964564580242194452/1259962545092034682/Forest_Grazer_Sexual_Dimorphism.png?ex=66903a0f&is=668ee88f&hm=a6005b42c702fafe7bfd03cb3b44a98cd60c5f5f1e7b6d50d872e7c2e5ddfc00&[/img]


[b]COMPLETED: Celevrix Dragon 3D Model Sheet~[/b]

Our leading concept artist Vitarius has completed another 3D model sheet, this time it is for another dragon, our special rolly boy Celevrix. This marks the 12 our of 15 dragon model sheets completed, meaning there is 3 more left to add into the 3D queue!

"What is a model sheet?"
We create something we call a 3D model sheet, this is to create multiple perspectives of the creature to give correct body proportions and guidelines for our 3D artists (people who create the actual models) to better understand the creature and how it might move. This speeds up the development of the creature greatly and of course, gives our artists less headache.

[b]Wraith's 3D Model in High Quality![/b]

Our beloved Flow has has completed the polish of the textures of our fearsome AI creature: Wraith! This monstrosity is for the time being going to be set aside as our skin team is still prioritising and assisting in the development of the new skin customisation for the test build. There is a turnaround however i cannot post it here so head over to our discord to take a look-!!


[b]NEW IMPLEMENTED Kirin Skins![/b]

Our skin team has been busy with some skinning. Our leading skin artist @SinfulVox has been finishing up two (2) brand new skins. These will be customisable in the test build and later tech demo. Which one is your favourite?

The Royal purple skin, inspires a little bit of that of a darkened sky with vague lightning pattern.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/964564580242194452/1259962916300656770/image.png?ex=66903a68&is=668ee8e8&hm=a18252f0d1ec6fe2b24c86317e0504bd21eddbc446c961917d5420981d919831&[/img]

From the little bit of a more exotic stand: the Ignis skin mimics that of a molten magma, with a dark obsidian-ish skin with lava bursting through from beneath.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/964564580242194452/1259963015730565162/image.png?ex=66903a7f&is=668ee8ff&hm=84f9ea4f4a051b9e15ab3c61ac3ad21c8f5254ed3269ee36d65fe3ba8f685a70&[/img]

Speaking of the upcoming skin customisation, here is a small teaser of us developers performing a small test on closed branch. Disclaimer that the bright colours will not be staying, we have not yet restricted the colour picking to more less saturated and natural-ish themes. However, there will be quite the range of colours to choose from. Below we have used Icy Crown for the testing. Vulgan and Kirin will be following suit very soon!

notes.title: Weekly Developer update
notes.notes:
Good morning, afternoon and evening everyone-!

We have decided to begin uploading our weekly updates that we do every Monday on discord here on Tuesdays. These updates are divided into 3 teams world, creatures and human/code this week is our code update, so here it is-!

This week we have a little bit of a shorter update as we visit the more technical side of things of the development. There are mostly two major features to be showcased this week which are very anticipated things to come!



[b]NEW Dragon Ability System~![/b]

Hatchet is working on a revamp of the ability system for dragons: this is done so that we can implement a more modular ability system for our powerful beasts. This will make the system far more flexible and easier to implement and improve when new dragons and new abilities are being added. This will also result in a more consistent behaviour in attacks between the server and client (the player), for short fixing a great deal of issues that we have currently in regards of visual errors and not knowing when/if you have been hit.

We are also looking forward to adding flinching animations later in the development, which will provide more easier visual cues to when a character is being hit. This will remove the constant need to keep an eye on your health bar or second guessing whether you hit or not.



[b]Setting up some fancy servers~![/b]

The last couple of weeks our senior programmer have been working on getting our new P4 server setup (w/ support for streams and parallel operations), with our custom engine fork of UE5, and converting the project to a "native" UE project which most Unreal tools by Epic expect. Working on setting up Horde w/ UnrealGameSync for automated builds + binaries distribution to the team, and once this is up and running and deploying builds to Steam, they will be moving onto setting up and integrating Epic Online Services in the game w/ EAC and steamworks.



[b]UPDATED Human "Heavy" Novice Bone Armour![/b]

Our lead concept artist, Vitaerris is moving ahead with redesigning more of our human armour concepts. Today we are showcasing the novice's "heavy" bone armour variants! Bone armour is going to be part of some of the early game for the humans, but rest assured it is going to be useful for the later parts of the game as well if so desired. We are giving each armour type their own "unique ability" you could say. This will make all armour in certain terms viable and ideal to craft instead of just quickly climbing the resources to get better armour as fast as possible.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/964564580242194452/1257426514677469369/Concept-Armor-Bone-Heavy.png?ex=668505f2&is=6683b472&hm=6f39181d73693e3287c21d477be90a55fe00e50aed09a518509c97bb9fbe83cb&[/img]



[b]NEW WIP Character Customisation System![/b]

[b]DISCLAIMER:[/b] this is our first pass on skin selection and customisation system! Nothing here is permanent and there is going to be loads of testing in the near future patches! We have not yet limited any of the colour wheel choices and selections, so excuse the bright and unnatural colours shown within the video, [b]this is only a very early work in progress.[/b]

[list]
[*] Here is a video featuring the basics of selecting skins. With Vulgan we currently have mostly static skins,  so you can see here our developer testing and scrolling through the available skins.
[/list]


[previewyoutube=83VSaOcpg8s;full][/previewyoutube]



[list]
[*] Another, an early work in progress skin customisation editor. Again, we do not have setup colour wheel restrictions or created any of the palette's yet. Right now it is still very simplistic and quite bright.
[/list]


[previewyoutube=oTGDu6xMmgw;full][/previewyoutube]


[list]
[*] Below you can see two testers side by side with their "customised" skins with different colours. A lot of those pesky replication issues (visual errors where a player's skin is not what its supposed to look like) has been fixed. Though there are still things to tweak and clean up before we feel comfortable to release it to the Patreon testers.
[/list]


[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/964564580242194452/1257426892492116050/image.png?ex=6685064d&is=6683b4cd&hm=58e0b4dc3ebc823687ca1c54eb075c831d90f88ab2195140b473bfd09de752aa&[/img]



[b]So what else is being worked on?[/b]



.   Optimisation continues as the forefront for the world and level design.
.   Reworked character selection backend to make it more modular and make it easier to expand with new dragons.
.   Skin selection and customisation will be tuned and refined.
                  .   Started work on rudimentary skin customisation through colour palette.
                  .   Our skin artists are working together with our programmers to make all skins from here on 
                   .   out (and possibly transferring over old skins into the new customisation-friendly state).
.   The new dragon ability system will be properly setup and requires further testing.
.   Working on creating our build graph for Steam deployment and servers. 




[b] NEW MONTHLY Development Video! [/b]

Last but not least, you know what's coming up! New month, new compilation of everything that has been worked on through June! Make sure to give a look, a like and share!  Let's get some reactive interaction going:




[previewyoutube=f963cUoApzM;full][/previewyoutube]



So that's everything this week , we will be doing these every Tuesday from now on , but if you want them early head over to our discord-!
